introduction: South Dakota Child Care Assistance accepts online and paper applications. Your application must identify the provider who will care for the child.
description: South Dakota Child Care Assistance accepts online and paper applications. Your application must identify the provider who will care for the child.

sections.who: The state reviews income and minimum work or school conditions. The provider must fit an eligible licensed, registered, relative or other approved care arrangement.
sections.get: Approved assistance covers eligible costs above the family contribution, within program limits.
sections.docs:
• Household income.
  • Work or school information.
  • Child and provider details.
sections.apply:
1. Apply online or download the form

    Use the child-care intake page.

  2. Confirm the provider

    Check that the arrangement meets the state’s provider requirements.

  3. Read the certificate

    If approved, review the monthly authorization and eligibility period. The provider receives a copy.
sections.after: Discuss the copayment and provider charges before care starts. Ask your benefits specialist about changes affecting the certificate.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Provider selection and application, Current financial screening, Work and school requirements. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state lists certain eligible relatives and other care arrangements; confirm the exact provider before relying on payment.
Will I receive an approval document?
Approved families receive a child-care certificate explaining assistance and eligibility dates.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
